newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Philippines' Ramos checks out of hospital.
newsitem.headline: Philippines' Ramos checks out of hospital.

text.p: Philippines President Fidel Ramos was discharged from hospital on Thursday, three days after an operation to remove a blockage in a major artery, radio reports said.
The privately-owned DZMM radio station said Ramos, with his wife Amelita, left the Makati Medical Centre shortly before 9 a.m. (0100 GMT) for the Malacanang presidential palace.

Ramos, 68, underwent surgery on Monday to remove a cholesterol blockage in his right carotid artery, one of the major passages for blood flowing to the brain. Officials had said the affliction could have been life-threatening.
But the president has recovered well and told reporters on Wednesday that he should be back to work by noon on thursday.
Ramos, smiling and looking fit, was mobbed by hospital employees and reporters as he left, witnesses said. Doctors escorted him to his car, but he walked unaided, they said.
